KNOWLEDGE

Knowledge

Technology explained in plain language — whether you're hearing about AI agents for the first time or you're deep in the field.

What is an AI agent?

An AI agent is an AI system that doesn't just respond, but independently plans and executes steps to reach a goal — for example researching information, using tools, or working through several tasks in sequence.

What's the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot?

A chatbot primarily answers questions in a dialogue. An AI agent goes further: it can break tasks into sub-steps, use tools and interfaces, and make decisions independently within a defined scope.

What does automation mean?

Automation describes systems that carry out recurring tasks without manual intervention — from simple rule sets to complex, AI-supported processes that adapt to changing situations.

What is prompt engineering?

Prompt engineering is the deliberate crafting of instructions for an AI system to achieve reliable, precise and repeatable results — comparable to giving a clear brief to a highly capable but very literal colleague.

Why combine software and hardware?

Intelligent software often only reaches its full potential once it can interact with the physical world. Combining logic with physical systems enables applications that go beyond the screen.

Many of the systems shown here are currently in development, prototyping, or still in the concept phase. This website deliberately documents that progress transparently — without making it look bigger than it is.

There are currently no published products, no customers, and no meaningful metrics we could show here. What does exist is a clear direction and continuous development work at the intersection of Intelligence, Logic and Physical.

This development is part of the brand's story — not something that needs to be hidden.

FUTURE VISION

Future Concept — not a product

VYRO-B

Visual Young Robot Operator — Buddy

VYRO-B is currently not a product and not a concrete development project with a fixed timeline. It is a long-term research vision: an intelligent physical AI companion that brings Intelligence, Logic and Physical together in one system.

This vision describes a possible direction Auvexis Systems could grow into over the long term — nothing more, nothing less.

ABOUT AUVEXIS

Why Auvexis Systems

Auvexis Systems is built on the conviction that intelligent software doesn't have to end at the screen. We combine AI systems, software engineering and physical prototyping in one shared development approach.

We deliberately address a broad audience: from individuals and freelancers who have little time to engage deeply with AI technology, to small and medium-sized businesses who want to use automation and AI agents meaningfully — without having to fight through buzzwords.
